Not the Tacoma 3.5L coil: dealer listings show 1.8L Corolla / Prius / C-HR / Matrix. The 2016-2023 Tacoma 3.5L (2GR-FKS) coil is 90919-A2008 (ToyotaPartsDeal, OEMGenuineParts; about $93-100) -- add it in batch 2.

Specifications
